lhs: Broadcast the operand and reduce precisely the chosen introduced axes in row-major order.
rhs: Multiply the original operand by the converted product of reduced extents, add a broadcast zero seed, then broadcast the result on the renumbered surviving axes.
conditions: Static ordered equal-mapped-extent broadcast with reductions only on inserted dimensions. Logical output coordinates valid. Unbounded exact Int, seed 0; arbitrary static rank/shape including zero.
types: Unbounded exact Int, seed 0; arbitrary static rank/shape including zero.
overlap: New terminal tensor relation uses prior mapped-axis transport and RNE integer rounding. Known constant-fold coefficient identity and prior fixed-order scalar uniform-sum rounding discrepancy are inherited arithmetic; not first discoveries.
